marquee.casino: Arkade is games with real stakes. Challenge people at chess, checkers or Last Man, and when you win the prize is paid straight into your wallet.
marquee.earn: Earn is work, not luck. Pick up gigs and small tasks, deliver them, and get paid into your wallet without ever placing a trade.
marquee.activity: Arkivity is your full money history. Every deposit, trade, win and withdrawal sits in one clean list, so you can always trace exactly where your money went.
marquee.invite: Invite friends is your referral link. Share it anywhere, and each time a friend signs up and makes their first deposit you get the credit. Rewards are on the way.

supportChat.greetingMessage: Hello! 👋 Welcome to live support. How can our team assist you with your account, trading, or deposits today?
supportChat.defaultAgentReply: Thank you for reaching out! A support engineer has received your message and will review your details shortly. If you have a transaction hash or screenshots, feel free to drop them here.
supportChat.depositHelpReply: For deposit issues: please ensure your transaction has confirmed on-chain. You can share your **transaction hash (TXID)** or deposit network here and we will inspect the indexing pipeline for you.
supportChat.tradeHelpReply: For trade questions: please share the **token symbol**, **network**, and approximate time of the order. Our routing system settles orders directly through decentralized liquidity pools.
supportChat.bugReportReply: Thank you for the report and details! Our frontend engineering team is looking into this glitch. If you have extra logs or console messages, you can paste them as a `code block`.

migrate.gateStuckBody: This keeps failing, and it’s not you. Your old account stays exactly as it is. Carry on for now and we’ll bring you back to this tomorrow.
migrate.walletBlockedTitle: Your browser is blocking the sign-in window
migrate.walletBlockedBody: Your old account signs in through a small window from privy.io, and this browser won’t let it load — usually an ad or tracker blocker, or third-party cookies being off. Allow privy.io or pause the blocker for this site, then reload. Or use another browser. Your old account stays exactly as it is until then.
migrate.gateWalletBlockedBody: This browser is blocking the sign-in window, so the upgrade can’t run here. Your old account stays exactly as it is. Fix the blocker and reload, or come back from another browser — we’ll bring you back to this tomorrow.

recovery.rotatedBody: Recovering on this device issued a new recovery file and retired the old one. Set a password for the new file, then save it somewhere safe.
recovery.fileBody: Download the file and keep it somewhere safe, like a password manager. Anyone with this file AND its password can restore the wallet; without the password it is useless.

recovery.pinSetupBody: This device can't use a passkey right now, so a PIN protects your wallet here. 4–8 digits. It is never sent anywhere and cannot be reset, so pick one you'll remember.
recovery.pinUnlockBody: This device unlocks your wallet with the PIN you chose here.
recovery.unlockPwSetupBody: Then you can unlock this device with just this password — no signing in. Use at least 12 characters, and not only digits. It can't be reset, so store it in your password manager.
